purposeContract.outcome: Find realistic food ideas and compare their nutrition when meal variety becomes useful.
purposeContract.mechanism: A searchable food directory organizes recipes and ingredient-level protein comparisons for an Indian cooking context.
purposeContract.proof: A public directory exists, but the result did not become compelling enough to justify active expansion.
purposeContract.nextAction: Browse the retained directory; new recipe work waits until cooking variety becomes a real owner need.

products.name: Research Papers
products.description: Search academic papers and follow original sources; account-based research chat is not yet qualified.

purposeContract.purpose: Research Papers is a structured, searchable library for discovering and interrogating academic and market research.
purposeContract.audience: The Fleet owner investigating a concrete product, technical, or market question.
purposeContract.outcome: Find relevant papers and retrieve grounded context from a large retained corpus.
purposeContract.mechanism: A curated research dataset is indexed for search and retrieval-assisted analysis with source structure intact.
purposeContract.proof: The corpus and discovery system are essentially complete and available when a real research question appears.
purposeContract.nextAction: Use the library for a named research question; maintain the corpus rather than expanding it speculatively.

products.name: RolePatch
products.description: A guest resume-tailoring experiment with a reviewable diff and browser-local document exports.

purposeContract.purpose: RolePatch tailors a resume and supporting application material to the evidence and language of a specific job.
purposeContract.audience: A job seeker preparing a serious application for a particular role.
purposeContract.outcome: Present relevant experience more clearly and prepare for the role without inventing qualifications.
purposeContract.mechanism: Paste a resume and job description, review the generated changes, save in the browser, and export the current document.
purposeContract.proof: The guest resume, tailoring, review, save/reload and local document-export path has been verified with synthetic examples. Account sync and broader application tools remain unqualified.
purposeContract.nextAction: Try the guest workflow for one job, review every proposed claim, and export the version you want to use.

products.name: SaaS Maker
products.description: A public directory of working experiments, reference projects and reusable tooling.

purposeContract.purpose: SaaS Maker is the public product studio and reusable tooling workshop for the Fleet portfolio.
purposeContract.audience: Visitors exploring Sarthak’s products and builders consuming the studio’s public packages, workflows, and evidence.
purposeContract.outcome: Understand the body of work and reuse the tools that have earned a stable place across its products.
purposeContract.mechanism: A generated public directory sits beside shared feedback, UI, workflow, skill, and automation tooling maintained through real Fleet use.
purposeContract.proof: It publishes the canonical privacy-safe project directory and houses packages and tooling used by multiple independent repositories.
purposeContract.nextAction: Explore the complete directory or open the public tooling catalogue; product-specific work continues in each owning repository.

products.name: Sarthak Agrawal
products.description: Selected engineering case studies, technical writing and working project demonstrations.

purposeContract.purpose: Sarthak Agrawal’s personal site is the durable public record of his work, writing, résumé, and professional identity.
purposeContract.audience: People evaluating Sarthak as an AI infrastructure and product engineer, collaborator, or builder.
purposeContract.outcome: Understand what he works on, what he has built, and how to verify or contact him.
purposeContract.mechanism: A maintained portfolio connects current positioning to selected projects, writing, résumé evidence, and public profiles.
purposeContract.proof: The public site is complete and satisfactory as the canonical professional record; updates follow changes in the underlying work.
purposeContract.nextAction: Explore the current work and résumé or use the listed contact paths; do not infer stale focus areas from older copy.

products.name: Starboard
products.description: Explore public GitHub repositories and related projects through a searchable discovery experiment.

purposeContract.purpose: Starboard makes a large GitHub Stars collection useful for personal exploration and project-aware tool discovery.
purposeContract.audience: Developers whose saved repositories have outgrown GitHub’s default starred-items interface.
purposeContract.outcome: Rediscover relevant tools, understand why they were saved, and connect them to current project needs.
purposeContract.mechanism: Synchronization, search, tags, lists, semantic retrieval, and project-aware recommendations operate over the user’s saved repositories.
purposeContract.proof: Core sync, search, organization, and project-aware discovery are largely complete and under focused active improvement.
purposeContract.nextAction: Connect or explore a Stars collection and use a current project question to drive discovery; avoid unrelated alert or reporting scope.

products.name: SWE Interview Prep
products.description: A learning OS for software-engineering interview practice.

purposeContract.purpose: SWE Interview Prep is a personal learning OS that turns software-engineering study into retained, artifact-backed understanding.
purposeContract.audience: Software engineers preparing for interviews or strengthening practical technical judgment through active study.
purposeContract.outcome: Build causal understanding that survives recall and can be demonstrated through code, diagrams, explanations, or projects.
purposeContract.mechanism: An evidence-gated Concept → Drill → Build → Review → Apply loop combines retrieval practice, Feynman explain-backs, roadmaps, and adaptive review.
purposeContract.proof: A fresh guest can complete a graded TypeScript drill and return to saved code in the same browser. Account sync and AI-graded mastery require sign-in and remain separately unqualified.
purposeContract.nextAction: Try a coding drill as a guest; progress stays in this browser. Use the issue tracker for account-sync qualification limits.

pastProjects.name: EverythingRated
pastProjects.description: A ratings experiment for comparing AI developer tools, with visible small-sample counts and shareable weighting.

purposeContract.purpose: EverythingRated makes anonymous opinions about AI developer tools visible axis by axis.
purposeContract.audience: Developers and technical operators comparing AI development tools for real projects.
purposeContract.outcome: Inspect trade-offs across Speed, Accuracy, Cost, Ergonomics and Integration depth, with the sample size visible.
purposeContract.mechanism: A public directory combines per-axis rating counts with weighted comparison links; unrated axes remain visibly unavailable.
purposeContract.proof: The hosted guest comparison covers a 24-tool directory with five axes. Initial owner ratings and small samples are early opinions, not benchmarks or consensus.
purposeContract.nextAction: Compare tools, inspect the per-axis evidence counts, and share a weighted comparison as an experiment. Rating submission is outside the verified guest workflow.

pastProjects.name: Mashup
pastProjects.description: Two playable examples of a local media-editing pipeline, with captions and inspectable source and approval receipts.

purposeContract.purpose: Mashup turns an owned creator archive into coherent topic-specific compilations while keeping every edit inspectable.
purposeContract.audience: A creator or operator assembling comedy, motivation, podcast, or clipping compilations from approved media.
purposeContract.outcome: Find, approve, sequence, and render useful clips without losing source provenance or editorial control.
purposeContract.mechanism: A local pipeline combines archive analysis, clipping, editable EDLs, source receipts, approval boundaries, and deterministic rendering.
purposeContract.proof: The first public Startups proof assembles a source-faithful 47-second argument from four beats across three Creative Commons podcast episodes, with captions and media receipts.
purposeContract.nextAction: Watch the public examples and inspect their source receipts. The local operator workflow and creator pilot remain separate from this showcase.

pastProjects.name: Protein Index
pastProjects.description: Explore dated nutrition records with original label links, observation dates and explicit verification limits.

purposeContract.purpose: Protein Index was built to catalogue and compare protein products available in India using trustworthy nutrition data.
purposeContract.audience: Indian shoppers comparing packaged protein sources on nutrition, price, and practical fit.
purposeContract.outcome: Inspect recorded nutrition alongside its source, observation date and verification authority.
purposeContract.mechanism: A product catalogue normalizes nutrition and comparison fields across available Indian protein products.
purposeContract.proof: Hosted search and detail expose dated source and authority labels; one original nutrition label and its density calculation were independently checked. This does not verify the entire catalogue.
purposeContract.nextAction: Explore dated records and inspect original labels; current product identity and packaging require separate verification.

pastProjects.name: Reddit Insights
pastProjects.description: Search a dated snapshot of 93 Reddit communities in your browser, with links to original posts and explicit provenance limits.

purposeContract.purpose: Reddit Insights studies how topics, signals, and emotional tone inside a subreddit change over time.
purposeContract.audience: A researcher or product operator following a specific community longitudinally.
purposeContract.outcome: Recognize recurring shifts and emerging concerns from a retained body of subreddit evidence.
purposeContract.mechanism: A bounded collector stores attributable snapshots and derives recurring insight views without claiming unavailable history.
purposeContract.proof: The collector and snapshot model exist, but reliable lawful access to historical Reddit data remains the central blocker.
purposeContract.nextAction: Use it for forward collection or retained snapshots; historical claims must wait for a lawful dependable source.

purposeContract.purpose: Web Playables is a small laboratory for learning how browser and YouTube-ready games are designed, packaged, and distributed.
purposeContract.audience: A builder studying reusable HTML5 game mechanics and portable distribution constraints.
purposeContract.outcome: Prototype a mechanic once and ship it as a normal web game and a submission-ready playable package.
purposeContract.mechanism: A reusable gamekit supplies loops, saves, offline progress, platform adapters, and builds for a small games hub.
purposeContract.proof: The research goal produced a working gamekit, a live idle game, and YouTube-compatible packaging; the project is now parked.
purposeContract.nextAction: Play the retained game or inspect the kit; add another game only when a specific mechanic is worth studying.
